'''Transcom WorldWide AB''' is a Swedish [[outsourcing|outsourcing company]] which provides [[customer care]], sales, [[technical support]], and collections services through an extensive network of contact centers and work-at-home agents.

The company operates in Europe, North and South America, Asia and North Africa. Transcom employs 29,000 customer experience specialists at 50 contact centers across 21 countries, delivering services in 33 languages to international brands in various industry verticals.

On December 21, 2016, Altor announced a public cash offer to the shareholders of Transcom to transfer all of their shares in Transcom to [[Altor Equity Partners|Altor]]. At the expiry of the final acceptance period in March 2017, Altor owned over 98 percent of the shares and votes in Transcom. The last day of trading in the Transcom share was 10 April 2017. Altor has resolved to call for compulsory redemption of the remaining shares in the company.{{Citation needed|date=August 2022}}

== History ==
On August 27, 2007, Transcom announced that it had acquired 100% of NuComm International for CAD$90 million.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=30 August 2007 |title=Transcom WorldWide Acquires NuComm |url=https://chiefmarketer.com/transcom-worldwide-acquires-nucomm/ |access-date=2025-02-05 |website=Chief Marketer |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2007-08-28 |title=European firm buys NuComm |url=https://www.thestar.com/business/european-firm-buys-nucomm/article_2563f8bd-b187-511e-80c3-d367575b739f.html |access-date=2025-02-05 |website=Toronto Star |url-access=subscription |language=en}}</ref> Réal Bergevin, the founder and CEO of NuComm, signed a contract to remain with the business under the new ownership.<ref name=":0" />

Transcom has a presence of 50 contact centers in addition to a large network of home agents in the following countries: Egypt, Canada, Croatia, Estonia, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Norway, the Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Serbia, Spain, Sweden, Tunisia, the United Kingdom, and the United States.<ref>{{cite web |title=Transcom Contact centres |url=https://www.transcom.com/contactus/ |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080808193137/http://www.transcom.com/Contacts/Contacts/ |archivedate=2008-08-08}}</ref>

On 1 December 2021, Transcom announced it would be opening a new call center in Greenville, South Carolina. The location is expected to create a minimum of 450 jobs in the new 33,000 sq. ft. space.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Atkinson |first=Macon |date=1 December 2021 |title=Greenville chosen for North American expansion of Transcom, which is to create 450 jobs |url=https://www.greenvilleonline.com/story/news/local/2021/12/01/transcom-chooses-greenville-sc-home-north-american-operations/8811183002/ |website=Greenville News}}</ref>

Brian Johnson was named president & CEO of Transcom on March 25, 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-18 |title=Transcom Holding AB (publ): Brian Johnson announced as Transcom's new President & CEO |url=https://news.cision.com/transcom-worldwide/r/transcom-holding-ab--publ--brian-johnson-announced-as-transcom-s-new-president---ceo,c3947080 |access-date=2025-03-12 |website=News Powered by Cision |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Ziptone |date=2024-03-18 |title=Brian Johnson succeeds Jonas Dahlberg as CEO of Transcom |url=https://www.ziptone.nl/en/nieuws/brian-johnson-volgt-jonas-dahlberg-op-als-ceo-transcom/#:~:text=The%20board%20of%20Transcom%20Holding,the%20CX%20and%20BPO%20field. |access-date=2025-03-12 |website=Ziptone - 100% klantcontact |language=en}}</ref>
